items.pattern: Present Simple or is/are in the if-clause of an unreal situation (If durians don't smell)
items.sk: Situácia je nereálna, preto po „if“ Past Simple: „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Situace je nereálná, proto po „if“ Past Simple: „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: The situation is unreal, so Past Simple after “if”: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: would added in the if-clause (If she would be a robot)
items.sk: V Second Conditional sa po „if“ „would“ nepíše: „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: V Second Conditional se po „if“ „would“ nepíše: „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: In Second Conditional there is no “would” after “if”: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: will/won't in the result of an unreal condition
whole sentence in First Conditional (If the beam is weaker, he will …) — use =full sentence
items.sk: Situácia je nereálna, preto Second Conditional: „if“ + Past Simple, potom „would“.
items.cz: Situace je nereálná, proto Second Conditional: „if“ + Past Simple, pak „would“.
items.en: The situation is unreal: Second Conditional, “if” + Past Simple, then “would”.

items.pattern: If I/he/she/it was instead of were
base verb in the if-clause (If he hold)
items.sk: Po „if“ v Second Conditional patrí Past Simple: „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Po „if“ v Second Conditional patří Past Simple: „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: After “if” in Second Conditional use Past Simple: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: had + past participle in the if-clause (If he had held) — refers to the past
items.sk: „{wrong}“ hovorí o minulosti; nereálna prítomnosť je „{right}“.
items.cz: „{wrong}“ mluví o minulosti; nereálná přítomnost je „{right}“.
items.en: “{wrong}” is about the past; an unreal present is “{right}”.

items.pattern: would have + past participle in the result (would have let them through)
items.en: “{wrong}” is about the past; here use “{right}”.

items.sk: Po „would“ nemôže stáť „can“; treba „would be able to“ alebo „could“.
items.cz: Po „would“ nemůže stát „can“; je potřeba „would be able to“ nebo „could“.
items.en: “would” can't be followed by “can”; use “would be able to” or “could”.

items.pattern: could + verb for by + verb where no ability is meant (customs could let them through)
items.en: “could” means “would be able to”; here the meaning is “{right}”.

items.pattern: past form, -s or to after would (would held, would to let)
items.en: After “would” use the base form: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: Past Simple + not instead of didn't + verb (smelled not)
items.sk: Zápor v Past Simple sa tvorí cez „didn't“: „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Zápor v Past Simple se tvoří přes „didn't“: „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.

items.pattern: subject before would in a question (What you would do if …?)
items.en: In a question “would” goes before the subject: “{right}”.

items.pattern: object pronoun after the particle of a phrasal verb (let through them)
items.en: The pronoun goes before the particle: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.sk: Krátke prídavné meno sa stupňuje cez -er: „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Krátké přídavné jméno se stupňuje přes -er: „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.

items.kind: until now instead of by now
items.pattern: until now for už (do tejto chvíle) (would be on the floor until now)
items.sk: „Už“ v zmysle „do tejto chvíle“ je „by now“; „until now“ znamená „doteraz“.
items.cz: „Už“ ve smyslu „do této chvíle“ je „by now“; „until now“ znamená „dosud“.
items.en: “by now” means “by this moment”; “until now” means “up to now”.

items.pattern: phrase translated word for word from Slovak/Czech (today morning, this night, there where)
items.sk: Doslovný preklad nesedí, po anglicky je to „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
items.cz: Doslovný překlad nesedí, anglicky je to „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
items.en: A word-for-word translation doesn't work: say “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

items.pattern: article dropped before a singular countable noun (pillow for a pillow)
items.sk: Pred počítateľným podstatným menom v jednotnom čísle chýba člen: „{right}“.
items.cz: Před počitatelným podstatným jménem v jednotném čísle chybí člen: „{right}“.
items.en: A singular countable noun needs an article: “{right}”.

items.pattern: wrong, extra or missing preposition copied from Slovak/Czech (struck into, on place)
